name: sivia
description: Understand papers and turn their core contributions into scientific overviews, with built-in detailed visual templates and editable figure reconstruction.

interface.shortDescription: Paper to image first; editable figures only on request.
interface.longDescription: Sivia reads manuscripts, selects paired image-and-prompt knowledge cases, and writes detailed ImageGen prompts with a per-figure length floor. It presents the generated image and pauses for user feedback. Visual approval locks the layout but does not authorize PPT creation: editable reconstruction starts only when the user explicitly requests it. PowerPoint/WPS construction preserves foreground focus, uses native editable objects, and replaces suitable fields with verified real images and data. Designer, Drawer, Reviewer and Corrector separate scientific correctness, visual fidelity and editability.
defaultPrompt: 使用 Sivia 理解这篇论文，借鉴知识库写精细 prompt 并生成 Overview 图片；先给我确认，不要直接制作 PPT。
仅修改这张 Overview 中我指出的部分，保留其余布局，先给我新的图片确认，不制作 PPT。
这张图已确认，请按原布局后台复刻成可编辑 PPT，并用项目真实图片和数据替换合适的示例字段。
